text_en: To the leader: according to The Deer of the Dawn. A Psalm of David.
text_cn: 达味诗歌，交与乐官，调寄"朝鹿"。

text_en: My God, my God, why have you forsaken me? Why are you so far from helping me, from the words of my groaning?
text_cn: 我的天主，我的天主，你为什么舍弃了我？ 你又为什么远离我的恳求，和我的哀号。

text_en: O my God, I cry by day, but you do not answer; and by night, but find no rest.
text_cn: 我的天主，我白天呼号，你不应允； 我黑夜哀祷，你仍默静。

text_en: Yet you are holy, enthroned on the praises of Israel.
text_cn: 但是你居于圣所， 作以色列的荣耀！

text_en: In you our ancestors trusted; they trusted, and you delivered them.
text_cn: 我们的先祖曾经依赖了你， 你救起他们，因他们依赖你；

text_en: To you they cried, and were saved; in you they trusted, and were not put to shame.
text_cn: 他们呼号了你，便得到救赎， 他们信赖了你，而从未蒙羞。

text_en: But I am a worm, and not human; scorned by others, and despised by the people.
text_cn: 至于我，成了微虫，失掉了人形； 是人类的耻辱，受百姓的欺凌。

text_en: All who see me mock at me; they make mouths at me, they shake their heads;
text_cn: 凡看见我的人都戏笑我， 他们都撇着嘴摇着头说：

text_en: “Commit your cause to the Lord ; let him deliver— let him rescue the one in whom he delights! ”
text_cn: “他既信赖上主，上主就应救他； 上主既喜爱他，也就该拯救他。”

text_en: Yet it was you who took me from the womb; you kept me safe on my mother’s breast.
text_cn: 是你使我由母腹中出生， 使我在母怀里享受安宁。

text_en: On you I was cast from my birth, and since my mother bore me you have been my God.
text_cn: 我一离开母胎，就已交托于你， 尚在母怀时，你已是我的天主。

text_en: Do not be far from me, for trouble is near and there is no one to help.
text_cn: 因为大难临头，求你不要远离我， 求你来近，因为无人肯来扶助我。

text_en: Many bulls encircle me, strong bulls of Bashan surround me;
text_cn: 成群的公牛围绕着我， 巴商的雄牛包围着我；

text_en: they open wide their mouths at me, like a ravening and roaring lion.
text_cn: 都向我张开自己的嘴， 活像怒吼掠食的狮子。

text_en: I am poured out like water, and all my bones are out of joint; my heart is like wax; it is melted within my breast;
text_cn: 我好像倾泻的水一般， 我全身骨骸都已脱散； 我的心好像是蜡， 在我内脏中溶化。

text_en: my mouth is dried up like a potsherd, and my tongue sticks to my jaws; you lay me in the dust of death.
text_cn: 我的上颚枯干得像瓦片， 我的舌头贴在咽喉上面； 你竟使我于死灰中辗转。

text_en: For dogs are all around me; a company of evildoers encircles me. My hands and feet have shriveled;
text_cn: 恶犬成群地围困着我， 歹徒成伙地环绕着我； 他们穿透了我的手脚，

text_en: I can count all my bones. They stare and gloat over me;
text_cn: 我竟能数清我的骨骼； 他们却冷眼观望着我，

text_en: they divide my clothes among themselves, and for my clothing they cast lots.
text_cn: 他们瓜分了我的衣服， 为我的长衣，他们拈（niān）阄（jiū）。

text_en: But you, O Lord , do not be far away! O my help, come quickly to my aid!
text_cn: 上主！请不要远离我， 我的勇力，速来助我。

text_en: Deliver my soul from the sword, my life from the power of the dog!
text_cn: 求你由刀剑下抢救我的灵魂， 由恶犬的爪牙拯救我的生命；

text_en: Save me from the mouth of the lion! From the horns of the wild oxen you have rescued me.
text_cn: 求你从狮子的血口救我脱身， 由野牛角下救出我这苦命人。

text_en: I will tell of your name to my brothers and sisters; in the midst of the congregation I will praise you:
text_cn: 我要向我的弟兄，宣扬你的圣名， 在盛大的集会中，向你赞美歌颂：

text_en: You who fear the Lord , praise him! All you offspring of Jacob, glorify him; stand in awe of him, all you offspring of Israel!
text_cn: “你们敬畏上主的人，请赞美上主， 雅各伯所有的后裔，请光荣上主， 以色列的一切子孙，请敬畏上主！

text_en: For he did not despise or abhor the affliction of the afflicted; he did not hide his face from me, but heard when I cried to him.
text_cn: 因他没有轻看或蔑视卑贱人的苦痛， 也没有向他掩起自己的面孔， 他一呼号上主，上主即予俯听。”

text_en: From you comes my praise in the great congregation; my vows I will pay before those who fear him.
text_cn: 我在盛大的集会中要向他颂赞， 我在敬畏他的人前还我的誓愿。

text_en: The poor shall eat and be satisfied; those who seek him shall praise the Lord . May your hearts live forever!
text_cn: 贫困的人必将食而饱饫（yù）， 寻求上主的人必赞颂主； 愿他们的心灵生存永久！

text_en: All the ends of the earth shall remember and turn to the Lord ; and all the families of the nations shall worship before him.
text_cn: 整个大地将醒觉而归顺上主， 天下万民将在他前屈膝叩首；

text_en: For dominion belongs to the Lord , and he rules over the nations.
text_cn: 因为唯有上主得享王权， 唯有他将万民宰治掌管。

text_en: To him, indeed, shall all who sleep in the earth bow down; before him shall bow all who go down to the dust, and I shall live for him.
text_cn: 凡安眠于黄泉的人都应朝拜他， 凡返回于灰土的人都要叩拜他。 我的灵魂存在生活只是为了他，

text_en: Posterity will serve him; future generations will be told about the Lord,
text_cn: 我的后裔将要事奉上主， 向未来的世代传述我主，

text_en: and proclaim his deliverance to a people yet unborn, saying that he has done it.
text_cn: 向下代人，传扬他的正义说： “这全是上主的所作所为！”
